nodes.label: Ticketmaster replaces google_events (rationale)
nodes.rationale: SerpApi google_events stopped returning real results and Bing Events also didn't trigger a carousel on this account, so the sync now calls Ticketmaster Discovery API directly, while keeping the misleading function/file name syncSerpApiEventsToSanity because daemonServer.ts and telegramHttpServer.ts import it by that exact name.

nodes.label: Pipeline V2 Stage 0-9 Funnel
nodes.rationale: Chains Stage 0-2 discovery, Stage 9 dedupe (moved early to avoid wasted work), Stage 3 sourcing, Stage 4 sufficiency, Stage 5 writing, Stage 6 verification, Stage 7 imaging, and Stage 8 assembly/publish into one funnel; every module is deliberately decoupled (local type redefinitions, port-don't-import) except this orchestrator, whose whole job is real wiring.

nodes.label: Port, Don't Import Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each Stage 3-8 module redefines input/output shapes locally and copies helper logic (e.g. openAiJson, htmlToPlainText, factId, AZ_CITY_HINTS) from sibling modules instead of importing them, keeping every stage standalone/shadow-mode and decoupled from production files, at the cost of duplicated logic that must be kept in sync manually.

nodes.label: Gemini model default choice rationale
nodes.rationale: gemini-2.5-flash retired; flagship 3.x flash/pro line hit live 503 capacity-shedding (25-75% failure) on 2026-08-27; gemini-3.1-flash-lite tested 21/21 successful across two runs same day, so it was set as default until flagship capacity crunch resolves.

nodes.label: Events roundup voice-tuning rationale
nodes.rationale: Locked 2026-08-26 after two live iterations judged by reading actual output: v1 uniform mild enthusiasm read flat; v2 explicitly demanded exclamation-level intensity on 1-2 standouts AND explicitly dialed non-standouts down further, producing the desired asymmetric contrast. Facts (venue/date/time/tickets) must stay accurate regardless of tone.

nodes.label: Gemini image-model fallback choice rationale
nodes.rationale: gemini-3.1-flash-image (flagship) timed out 5/5 live due to the same capacity crunch as flagship text models; gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image got 12/15 (80%), remaining failures being timeouts not 503s, so the lite variant plus a longer timeout was chosen over the flagship.

nodes.label: alternateSourceUrls Stage 3 fallback rationale
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 web_search fallback URLs are persisted (URL only, no title/summary) so processSelectedTopics() can thread them into Stage 3 as searchSummaries, giving a dashboard-selected candidate a real fallback source if the primary sourceUrl is unfetchable (bot-blocked, paywalled, redirect loop) — matching the automated pipeline's existing behavior.

nodes.label: stage0Usage provider-accounting rationale
nodes.rationale: Per-provider (Bright Data vs SerpAPI) Stage 0 call accounting is stored on syncRun so it is directly queryable which provider actually discovered a run's items, rather than requiring log-diving.

nodes.label: 30-day duplicate lookback rationale
nodes.rationale: Duplicate detection uses a 30-day pool wider than dedupeFeature.ts's RECENT_WINDOW_DAYS=7 (tuned for pre-publish recall) because auditContent's check is cheap (Sanity reads + key comparisons only, no image generation) and needs to catch drift across audit runs, not just at publish time.

nodes.label: 429 backoff schedule rationale
nodes.rationale: RATE_LIMIT_RETRY_DELAYS_MS exists because a run needing several gpt-image-1 fallbacks fired OpenAI calls back-to-back with no spacing, tipping a 6-post run into a 100% 429 rate on 2026-08-25 (syncRun sESRA9nn5E6yWErUIplHQK).

nodes.label: sidebar adSize ambiguity rationale
nodes.rationale: placement 'sidebar' maps to either mpu-300x250 or halfpage-300x600 with no deterministic rule, so it is only reported and requires an explicit --sidebar=<id>=<adSize> override before --write will apply it.

nodes.label: Nominatim rate-limit compliance rationale
nodes.rationale: REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS=1100 and a descriptive User-Agent follow Nominatim's usage policy (max 1 req/sec for a one-off, non-recurring run) in place of an API key.

nodes.label: originalSourceUrl realDoc-write-gap rationale
nodes.rationale: This backfill exists because publishAssembledDocument() in publishAssembly.ts never carried originalSourceUrl from the assembled preview object into the real Sanity write for pipeline_v2 posts published before the fix; the value is recovered by parsing the existing disclaimer's 'Sourced from: Outlet (URL)' text and taking the first URL as the closest proxy for the original topic.link.

nodes.label: generalized-from-dispensary-script rationale
nodes.rationale: backfillVenueCoordinatesNominatim.ts is a generalized version of backfillDispensaryCoordinatesNominatim.ts (parameterized by BACKFILL_TYPE to also cover restaurant/nightlife); the original dispensary script is deliberately left unchanged since it already ran against production, and its stripUnitDesignator fix (single-pass keyword+suffix stripping) supersedes the earlier two-pass version's dangling-'Suite '-token bug.

nodes.label: Sanity content-hash re-source retry pattern
nodes.rationale: Sanity's asset store dedupes uploads by content hash, so a fresh sourceImage() call that happens to redownload the SAME underlying Unsplash photo produces the identical asset id even though it's a new upload call. The original duplicate's own Unsplash photo ID was never recorded pre-heroImageUnsplashId, so it can't be pre-excluded by ID. Fix: retry sourceImage()/upload against the real resulting Sanity asset id, excluding whichever Unsplash photo ID produced it, until a genuinely different asset comes back (confirmed live during the Labor Day manual fix).

nodes.label: Persona/style composable prompt design
nodes.rationale: Persona (voice) and style (structure) are independent dimensions layered onto the base Stage 5 prompt as optional appended prompt-file blocks, rather than auto-selected by topic.section as the legacy writerAgent.ts PERSONALITY_BY_SECTION mechanism did. Caller passes persona/style explicitly (e.g. from a human-selected topicCandidate.selectedPersona) so undefined = no append = today's default output. 'stephen-a-spliff-unhinged' is modeled as its own persona value (own prompt file, same displayName) rather than a new toggle dimension, to fit the existing selectedPersona dropdown/allowlist with zero new plumbing.

nodes.label: Dedupe key design (entity+city+date vs no-date)
nodes.rationale: Two dedupe keys exist deliberately: buildDedupeKey (with date) for the symmetric same-run seenThisRun comparison, and buildDedupeKeyNoDate for the asymmetric Sanity cross-run comparison, since deriveDedupeKeyFromExistingPost can never include a date (an existing post's publishedAt is a publish timestamp, not the event date) — comparing full keys across those two contexts could never match by design.

nodes.label: Cross-run image duplicate-avoidance design
nodes.rationale: Same-process in-memory window (150 photos) catches only same-run duplicates and resets on restart; a Sanity-backed heroImageUnsplashId query was added for cross-run (90-day) dedup once schemas/post.ts began persisting that field, since publishAssembledDocument previously discarded the Unsplash photoId after upload, leaving nothing to query against.

nodes.label: seenThisRun same-run dedupe cross-check
nodes.rationale: Sanity's fetchRecentPosts only sees posts published in previous runs, so two sibling candidates discovered in the same run (e.g. the Ketel Marte casino sighting covered by two outlets) would never be cross-checked against each other without an in-memory seenThisRun accumulator threaded through the topic loop.

nodes.label: Section as single source of truth for categories
nodes.rationale: Fixes a confirmed bug in agents/sanityPublisher.ts's publishGoogleNewsArticleToSanity where categories[] unioned the slot-derived category with the model's own free-form article.categories, letting a meteor-shower article get filed under health-wellness. Fix: Stage 2's topic.section is the ONLY source of truth for categories/category ref; article.categories is never read.
nodes.norm_label: section as single source of truth for categories

nodes.label: Prose-quality gate over raw character length
nodes.rationale: Raw character count alone can't distinguish real article prose from a long run of nav-link fragments; confirmed against a real 483-char nav-link run and a 767-char nav-boilerplate page that both cleared PAGE_FETCH_MEANINGFUL_MIN_CHARS on length alone, so a minimum sentence-shaped-chunk count (stopword-ratio + length window) was added as a second gate.
nodes.norm_label: prose-quality gate over raw character length

nodes.label: Fact conflict policy — flag, never silently resolve
nodes.rationale: When two valid facts share a field but disagree, the module never averages or silently prefers one; the field still counts toward qualifyingFactCount but is recorded in a `conflicts` array with every value+source intact, deferring resolution to Stage 5/6 or a human editor.
nodes.norm_label: fact conflict policy — flag, never silently resolve

nodes.label: Business/deal sufficiency exception
nodes.rationale: An acquisition/merger story (JARS Cannabis / Sonoran Roots) has no venue and no event-shaped date, so it can never satisfy the WHAT/WHEN core-field path even when clearly substantial — added as an additive full-article path gated on a title keyword regex plus a concrete deal-detail regex, deliberately not generalized to other topic shapes like science reporting or listicles.

nodes.label: Bright Data primary / SerpAPI fallback per-query
nodes.rationale: Bright Data is tried first per query, falling back to SerpAPI on error, timeout, non-200, or a genuinely empty result set — decided per query rather than per run so one query's Bright Data hiccup doesn't force every other query onto SerpAPI.
nodes.norm_label: bright data primary / serpapi fallback per-query

nodes.label: Category-reserved Stage 1 slots (cannabis/lifestyle/sports/health-wellness)
nodes.rationale: Four category classes (cannabis-az, lifestyle-az, sports-az, health-wellness-az) each get reserved Stage1 candidate slots because pure combined-recency ranking let weather/breaking-news dominate and starved these categories out entirely in confirmed real runs, mirroring the same under-representation investigation each time.

nodes.label: Two-check verification gate design (mechanical then prose)
nodes.rationale: Check 1 (mechanical phantomFactCount/phantomSourceCount) runs first, free, and any failure short-circuits before spending an OpenAI call on Check 2's prose-fidelity scoring — verifying prose built on an already-known-bad foundation is wasted cost.
nodes.norm_label: two-check verification gate design (mechanical then prose)
